asmc.observation: It was dry and cloudy over the southern ASEAN region overnight, apart from the northern and central parts of Sumatra and the northern parts of Borneo where there were some showers. Widespread hotspots were detected in the southern parts of Kalimantan and the southern and central parts of Sumatra, while few hotspots were detected elsewhere in the southern ASEAN region. Moderate to dense smoke haze was observed to cover over parts of Kalimantan, the southern parts of Sarawak, the southern and central parts of Sumatra and the southern parts of Papua. Air quality stations in Borneo and Sumatra reported Unhealthy to Hazardous levels. The full extent of the hotspot and smoke haze situation over the southern ASEAN region could not be determined due to extensive cloud cover. Dry conditions were observed over the Mekong sub-region overnight, while showers were observed over the Philippines. Hotspot activity over the northern ASEAN region remained low.

warning_flags: Hotspot counts are detections, not a count of fires; cloud and haze can obscure detections.
4 hotspot points could not be assigned uniquely to a province.
Thermal marks are satellite detections, not proof of local smoke or absence of fires.
